target: Complete, checked, useful traveler-facing Results answers with grounded comparisons and exact source identities, ordinarily below 20 seconds; a small overage is tolerable. Include selection, composition, any correction, counts, preparation, checks and resolution in runtime.
review_clarification: Applies existing ADR0029: evaluate comparative advice in local displayed-reference context; a stronger unshown representative is coverage unless it falsifies or materially misleads the asserted argument. No global optimum/frontier or strongest-representative hard C quota. Preserve original judgments and explicit source-backed adjudications. Recorded before final confirmation; see docs/reviews/2026-10-28-results-q020-adjudication.md. Prospective v1.2 calibration follows the independent V13 oracle audit: evaluate supported displayed gains/losses without a strongest-representative quota, retain genuinely basic dominated contrasts and disputed wording; preserve original scout grades and both denominators. See docs/reviews/2026-10-28-results-v13-adjudication.md.

quality.hard: No material factual, identity, role or comparison error; useful complete recommendation or truthful no-complete-result outcome with applicable limitations.
quality.graded: Require the complete M2 traveler answer: a meaningful Ranking-informed choice (one may be enough), individual reason and downside, a connected supported comparative argument when alternatives add value, embedded references, relevant cash baseline when available, and consolidated limitations. Decision-rich depth is the goal unless source evidence is sparse; record justified exceptions.
quality.review: Use blind source-grounded review bundles. Preserve every attempted run and disagreement. Do not infer owner presentation acceptance or population reliability from saved cases.
